text: No, the property did not lose tree cover in 2024. The data shows that there was a tree-cover loss event in 2023, affecting 0.7 hectares (1.2% of the property). The total area of these small patches in 2024 was 0.7 hectares, but since they fall below the minimum event threshold, they do not qualify as significant tree-cover loss.
